mechanism: Amikacin is nephrotoxic and ototoxic; efavirenz may increase CNS penetration of aminoglycosides and both agents can cause ototoxicity and renal impairment, particularly with prolonged use or in patients with baseline renal dysfunction.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and hearing regularly; ensure adequate hydration; consider therapeutic drug monitoring of amikacin levels; assess for signs of ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity throughout treatment.
